date_selection_rule: second Wednesday of February, May, August and November 2025, then February and May 2026; fixed before querying any market observation for the cohort
candidate_selection_rule: among symbols that causally reach the current-general-2026 price/gain/same-time-RVOL gate, select the earliest first_market_qualified_at values with symbol ascending as the only tie-breaker
selection_prohibitions: do not select on maximum later gain, maximum later RVOL, session high, plan count, fill count, P&L or any Ross behavior label
do not replace a date or candidate because the replay is inactive, unavailable or unfavorable to an ablation
do not call an unlabelled candidate a false positive or a human-trade mismatch
primary_readout: paired plan-count and modeled-fill-count deltas for volume-only versus baseline
paired plan-count and modeled-fill-count deltas for context-plus-volume versus context-only
changes in first modeled plan and fill timing or pullback ordinal
context main effects and volume-by-context interaction counts
interpretation_limits: this is a conditional micro-layer activity stress test, not a full scanner backtest
modeled fills are independent diagnostic opportunities and do not represent portfolio or campaign state
without retrospective behavior labels this cohort cannot score imitation accuracy
without point-in-time float, news and rank this cohort cannot estimate scanner false-positive rate
no result from this cohort alone may promote a policy
